## Certification Target: `=== RAWRXD_PRODUCT_FINAL_001 ===`

### Acceptance Scenario
Fresh clone. No hidden environment variables. No development-only stubs. No manually pre-created receipt.

```
launch RawrXD
      Γåô
select local model
      Γåô
select R9700
      Γåô
open project
      Γåô
tell agent:
"Find the bug, fix it, build it and test it."
      Γåô
agent reads project
      Γåô
GPU reasons
      Γåô
CPU Tool Authority operates
      Γåô
source edited
      Γåô
build fails once
      Γåô
model diagnoses it
      Γåô
second edit
      Γåô
build succeeds
      Γåô
tests succeed
      Γåô
reviewer GPU reviews patch
      Γåô
agent reports evidence
      Γåô
Git commit
```
